explicit_goal: 部署到云端服务器，按 README 接续，冒烟测试出报告和问题，修复并将代码和报告打包提交 PR。
default_basis: The user attached this cloud execution environment; no separate SSH target or external cloud identity is configured.
delivery_boundary: Runnable Python CLI deployment, S01 offline audit closure, S02 versioned protocol candidate, S03 fresh native worker smoke, repairs, regression and portable archive/PR.

requirements.assertion: Install runnable CLI in the attached cloud environment and verify outside the source checkout.
Complete or explicitly qualify A01-A05 using immutable originals and a fresh independent Luna auditor.
Freeze a versioned S02 protocol before a fresh S03 native worker; preserve original candidates and bounded fixes.
Exercise success, rejected inputs, checkpoint reuse and changed evidence; preserve command return codes and reports.
Publish full source and reports to a feature branch and PR; include reproducible archive generation and hashes.

limits: Not a permanent externally hosted service or an HTTP endpoint.
Managed environment lifetime is controlled by the host.
No provider SDK/global-resource/network-fault/UI/performance acceptance inferred from local tests.
At most two functional repair rounds for each candidate; setup mistakes retained separately.
